# See Through Network Recruitment Automation

## Context

As more people hear about the Network, more people are approaching us via our website Join Us button, the need to streamline this process grows.

The procedure works well as a user experience, but some degree of automation would:

1. Reduce the administrative burden by eliminating routine manual processes  
2. Enable HR Manager and team to monitor progress  
3. Provide useful automated reports for HR team and other network managers

## Current procedure

Potential recruits click the ‘Join as an Individual’’ button in the Individual tab of the [How To Help section](https://www.seethroughtogether.org/#join) at the bottom of the STT homepage.

This button links to [this Google Form](https://forms.gle/cDH4PVSBscFzvYY88)

1. The HR manager sees an email flagging a new response in the [seethroughnetwork@gmail.com](mailto:seethroughnetwork@gmail.com) Gmail account.  
     
2. The HR Manager sends the applicant an email using Template 1 below.  
     
3. The HR Manager considers the application and sends the applicant an email using Template 2 below.  
     
4. If the applicant fails to respond within a week or so, the HR Manager sends a follow-up email to check they have received it OK, or are no longer interested in joining the network.  
     
5. If the applicant responds with the requested 5 window options for an introductory video call, the HR Manager emails them a Google Meet invitation for one of the slots.  
     
6. HR team and applicant have an introductory video call via Google Meet, and the applicant either becomes a Colleague on one or more projects or teams, or decides not to.

## Email template 1: Procedure explanation

Subject Line:  You See Through Network Application

Dear \[applicant first name\],

Many thanks for your application form. We look forward to finding the best for the See Through ecosystem to make the most of your skills, interest, time and energy to *Speed Up Carbon Drawdown by Helping the Inactive Become Active.*

Here's what will happen now:

1\) ASSESSMENT  
Our HR team (all human \- no robots\!) will review your application, and find the best matches to available roles within the See Through Ecosystem.   
They’ll look for the best balance between the See Through’s priorities and your skills, interests, commitment and professional development goals (one of the advantages of not having a bank account is we focus only on mutual benefit, unconstrained by budget or funding).

2\) SHORTLIST  
We'll email you a shortlist of three suggested projects, including links to detailed explanations, and the HR team’s reasons for why they thought they might be a good match.

Please note there’s no obligation to select one from the shortlist before requesting a video meeting. You can pick more than one, or something completely different. The purpose of the shortlist is to provide focus for finding the best match for you, based on your application \- video meetings might well, and often do, uncover better options.

3\) REVIEW  
You take as long as you like to follow the links in the shortlist, research the shortlisted projects in depth, consider how they match your priorities, interests, availability and ambitions.

If we don’t hear from you within a week, we’ll send one follow-up email just to make sure you’ve received it. If you don’t receive your Shortlist within a week, please email 

4\) SCHEDULING: You send us 5 x 1-hour slot options to schedule video meeting when you're available over the following week, and we'll send you a Google Meet invitation.

5\) VIDEO MEETING: Network members managing, or familiar with, the shortlisted projects will discuss your potential role and answer any questions.

Then, having helped you become Active, you can help us help others to Speed Up Carbon Drawdown\!

We hope to get the ball rolling by emailing you your bespoke Shortlist in the next two days,

Best wishes, 

See Through HR

## Email template 2: Shortlist explanation

Dear \[applicant first name\],

The See Through HR team has carefully considered the application you sent us dated  \[insert application date\].

Based on the information you provided and the Network’s current priorities/needs, here’s our Shortlist of three projects for you to consider before scheduling an introductory video meeting.

\[PROJECT 1 WITH LINK to STT webpage or article\]: we think this might be a good match because \[reasons why it’s a good match\]

\[PROJECT 2 WITH LINK to STT webpage or article\] we think this might be a good match because \[reasons why it’s a good match\]

\[PROJECT 3 WITH LINK to STT webpage or article\] we think this might be a good match because  \[reasons why it’s a good match\]

Please take as long as you need to research these projects, bearing in mind they are only intended to focus the discussion in our introductory video meeting. There’s no obligation to pick only one, or to limit your choice to this shortlist.

When you’re ready, please email 5 hour slots (including your time zone) when you’re available in the next week, and we’ll send you a Google Meet link for the one that best suits the most appropriate person or team to attend your introductory meeting.

Looking forward to working together to Speed Up Carbon Drawdown by Helping the Inactive Become Active,

\[name of HR team member who drew up shortlist\]  
See Through Network HR team
